description: Static bloat review for one SVG. Pass `svg`. Flags XML prolog and DOCTYPE, comments, editor markers (Inkscape, Sodipodi, Sketch, Illustrator, Figma, default Layer ids), generator notes used as title, path numbers with more than 3 decimals (with the characters that rounding to 2 or 3 would remove), hidden elements, empty and attribute-less wrapper groups, unreferenced ids, unused clip paths, masks, gradients and filters, attributes at default values, embedded base64 bitmaps, live text, matrix transforms, a missing viewBox, and script or external references. This tool does not rewrite or optimise the SVG and does not claim output; the byte estimate counts characters that the listed items occupy. Use SVGO or similar and compare the render.
name: check_svg_bloat
title: SVG bloat check
